experiment_design.best_replay_selection: One illustrative best episode per difficulty per policy, selected from held-out seeds by completion, gem fraction, return, then fewer steps. Replay selection does not change aggregate held-out metrics or model selection.
experiment_design.mcts_note: MCTS has access to the simulator during planning and is a planning reference, not a matched-sample learner.

caveats: This is a modest CPU experiment, not exhaustive hyperparameter tuning.
Two training seeds and two configurations provide only a preliminary comparison.
Each difficulty-specific best-attempt replay is selected from 50 test seeds; aggregate metrics use all 50.
Bandits, dynamic programming, uninformed search, and general local/heuristic search have no separate executable policy in this implementation.
